description:
Set up the NIST PKITS (Public Key Interoperability Test Suite, NIST SP 800-89) as the primary integration test baseline for pkix-path.

BLOCKED BY: Epic PKIX-lwr (path validator) and Epic PKIX-ehn (RustCrypto backends). Test infrastructure can be written earlier but tests will not pass until both are done.

PKITS is the industry-standard test suite for RFC 5280 implementations. It ships as a ZIP containing ~500 DER-encoded certificates and CRLs covering every section of RFC 5280 path validation.

Source: https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/pki-testing
Oracle: the PKITS document itself specifies expected pass/fail for each test. No code-under-test oracles.

Fixtures:
  Commit all PKITS DER certificates and CRLs under pkix-path/tests/pkits/certs/ and pkix-path/tests/pkits/crls/. Record the SHA-256 of the PKITS ZIP in a README in that directory for reproducibility.

Test infrastructure:
  A pkits_chain!() macro or helper function that takes PKITS cert filenames (as used in the PKITS document), loads the DER, parses, constructs the chain in the right order, and runs validate_path against the PKITS trust anchor. Returns Result so expected-fail tests can assert on the error variant.

v0.1 test sections (all must be green):
  §4.1  Signature Verification (4.1.1–4.1.6) — basic happy paths
  §4.2  Validity Period (4.2.1–4.2.8) — expired, not-yet-valid, edge cases
  §4.3  Verifying Data Signed by a CA (4.3.1–4.3.2) — BasicConstraints
  §4.6  Verifying Basic Constraints (4.6.1–4.6.20) — cA, pathLenConstraint
  §4.7  Key Usage (4.7.1–4.7.3) — keyCertSign

Skipped sections (document as expected-skip, not expected-fail):
  §4.8  Certificate Policies — not implemented in v0.1
  §4.10 Name Constraints — not implemented in v0.1
  §4.11 Private Certificate Extensions — not applicable
  §4.13 Delta CRLs — not applicable for v0.1

Sub-issues to create:
1. Obtain and commit PKITS DER fixtures
2. PKITS test helper infrastructure (chain loader, trust anchor, assertion helpers)
3. §4.1 Signature Verification tests
4. §4.2 Validity Period tests
5. §4.3 + §4.6 BasicConstraints tests
6. §4.7 Key Usage tests
7. Document skipped sections in pkix-path rustdoc Limitations

Acceptance: all v0.1 PKITS sections green, skipped sections documented.
